title: 末班车 EP01
synopsis: 林岚在深夜车站咖啡馆等了四十分钟，迟到的父亲带着一个她不想听到的消息走进来。

characters.name: 林岚
characters.identity_phrase: a woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length black hair, an oval face, dark brown eyes and a dark-green field jacket over a white tee
characters.voice_phrase: a woman in her late twenties with a low, slightly husky voice and an unhurried pace

characters.name: 林父
characters.identity_phrase: a man in his late fifties with a short grey beard, deep-set eyes, a weathered face and a navy wool coat
characters.voice_phrase: a man in his fifties with a deep, quiet voice

scenes.name: the station café at night
scenes.description: a small station café at night: one laminate counter, three stools, a humming drinks fridge, cool fluorescent light inside and warm street light through the rain-streaked front window

props.name: the paper coffee cup
props.description: a plain white paper coffee cup with a brown cardboard sleeve

shots.framing: a medium shot from across the counter
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: {lin_lan} sits on the middle stool facing the camera, both hands wrapped around the paper cup, eyes on the door; she checks her phone, exhales, and looks up as the door bell rings

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: her jaw tightens, she sets the cup down without looking away from the door

segments.soundscape: Rain on the front window, the low hum of a drinks fridge, a phone screen tapped twice, the door bell ringing once at 00:05 followed by wet footsteps and a paper cup set down on laminate.
segments.end_state: {lin_lan} staring past the camera toward the door, cup set down in front of her
segments.negatives: No other customers, no signage text, no subtitles

shots.framing: a medium shot of the doorway
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {father} steps in from frame right with rain on his shoulders, stops, and faces the camera; he does not take off his coat

dialogue.speaker: father
dialogue.text: 末班车停了，我是走过来的。

shots.framing: an over-the-shoulder shot from behind {father}, who stands at frame right, a head taller
shots.camera: The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: {lin_lan} faces the camera from her stool at frame left; she studies him, then slides the cup toward him across the counter

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: his hand closes around the cup but does not lift it; the hand is trembling slightly

segments.soundscape: The door bell fades, wet footsteps on tile, a paper cup sliding on laminate, the drinks fridge hum, rain steady on the window.
segments.continuity: The café, lighting and {lin_lan}'s position on the middle stool are unchanged from the previous segment; the cup stands where she set it down.
segments.end_state: {father}'s trembling hand around the cup in close-up
segments.negatives: No other customers, no signage text, no subtitles

shots.framing: a two-shot across the counter, 林父 at frame right facing 林岚 at frame left
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward 林父
shots.action: 林父 looks up from the cup, holds her gaze, and speaks; 林岚 listens with her mouth closed and does not move

dialogue.speaker: father
dialogue.text: 你妈的事……医生今天给了我一个日期。

segments.soundscape: Rain on the window, the fridge hum dropping away as he speaks, a single distant train horn at the very end.
segments.music: A single sustained low cello note enters under the last word and holds, no swell.
segments.continuity: Same positions, lighting and wardrobe as the previous segment.
segments.end_state: a hard hold on 林岚's frozen face as the train horn sounds
segments.negatives: No other customers, no signage text, no subtitles
